mapping_boundary: Framework profile mappings are directional coverage aids, not clause equivalence or proof of conformity.

supporting_references.name: ISO/IEC 27002:2022
supporting_references.use: Licensed implementation guidance for ISO/IEC 27001 controls

supporting_references.name: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0
supporting_references.use: Privacy risk outcomes; monitor the 1.1 draft but do not treat it as final

controls.title: Define scope, boundary, owners, and release authority
controls.intent: Identify repositories, components, environments, trust boundaries, assets, responsible owners, and the exact release authorization path.

controls.title: Complete applicability decisions and pin sources
controls.intent: Classify every catalog profile, resolve high-risk unknowns, and lock exact source versions and digests for the release.

controls.title: Operate policies, roles, reviews, and temporary exceptions
controls.intent: Maintain approved security policies, segregation of duties, management reviews, and expiring risk exceptions with accountable owners.

controls.title: Maintain threat model and risk treatment
controls.intent: Document data flows, trust boundaries, attackers, abuse cases, failure modes, mitigations, residual risks, and change triggers.
evidence: Risk treatment and accepted residual risk

controls.title: Inventory assets, data, dependencies, vendors, and subprocessors
controls.intent: Maintain a machine-readable inventory covering software, infrastructure, data stores, third parties, owners, classifications, and lifecycle state.

controls.title: Minimize data and enforce its lifecycle
controls.intent: Define collection purpose, lawful/approved use, consent, retention, deletion, export, backup treatment, residency, sharing, and disposal for every data class.
evidence: Rights-request or user-control tests where applicable

controls.title: Align behavior, consent, disclosures, and third parties
controls.intent: Make public privacy disclosures, in-product consent, data inventory, manifests, SDK behavior, and observed network traffic truthful and consistent.

controls.title: Implement secure identity, authentication, enrollment, and recovery
controls.intent: Use phishing-resistant authentication where appropriate and test enrollment, recovery, revocation, suspicious changes, and fallback paths.
evidence: Automated positive and negative authentication tests

controls.title: Protect privileged access and workforce identity
controls.intent: Require phishing-resistant MFA, least privilege, separate administration, timely joiner/mover/leaver actions, and auditable elevation for privileged users.

controls.title: Enforce server-side authorization and tenant isolation
controls.intent: Deny by default and test object-, function-, field-, role-, resource-, and tenant-level authorization on every trusted service boundary.

controls.title: Protect sessions, tokens, and critical actions
controls.intent: Apply secure cookies where relevant, short-lived tokens, rotation, revocation, replay defenses, step-up authentication, safe logout, and server validation.

controls.title: Eliminate embedded and exposed secrets
controls.intent: Keep credentials, private keys, privileged tokens, signing material, and master keys out of source, binaries, bundles, logs, fixtures, images, and CI output.
evidence: Credential inventory and rotation evidence for any finding
Binary and bundle secret scan where applicable

controls.title: Use approved cryptography and managed key lifecycles
controls.intent: Use platform-standard cryptography, protected key storage, rotation, separation, revocation, backup, and destruction; never invent custom cryptography.
evidence: Exact validation evidence when FIPS is required

controls.title: Secure network communication and trust validation
controls.intent: Enforce HTTPS/TLS, valid certificate and hostname checks, scoped CORS, CSRF defenses where relevant, safe redirects, secure headers, and authenticated service traffic.
evidence: Header, CORS, and CSRF tests where applicable

controls.title: Validate untrusted input and encode output
controls.intent: Use schemas, parameterized operations, contextual encoding, safe deserialization, upload validation, SSRF defenses, and bounded parsers.
evidence: Fuzz or malformed-input tests for exposed parsers

controls.title: Defend business logic and resource use
controls.intent: Test workflow abuse, anti-automation, rate limits, quotas, idempotency, race conditions, replay, fraud paths, and graceful degradation.
evidence: Fraud and replay assessment where applicable

controls.title: Fail safely without debug or sensitive errors
controls.intent: Remove test bypasses and debug interfaces, minimize error detail, fail closed on security decisions, and preserve safe rollback behavior.

controls.title: Require protected changes, review, and security impact declarations
controls.intent: Bind changes to reviewed requirements, peer approval, protected branches, security impact, tests, and traceable remediation.

controls.title: Run automated code, dependency, secret, and infrastructure checks
controls.intent: Use pinned SAST, SCA, secret, IaC, container, configuration, and license rules appropriate to the components and fail closed on missing output.

controls.title: Run dynamic, API, authorization, and fuzz testing
controls.intent: Exercise deployed behavior, APIs, tenant boundaries, parsers, uploads, protocol edges, and abuse paths in an authorized nonproduction environment.

controls.title: Obtain independent security testing for high assurance
controls.intent: Use a qualified independent assessor for material architecture changes and high-assurance releases; track remediation to evidence.
evidence: Independent test scope and report locator

controls.title: Pin dependencies and produce complete SBOM and provenance
controls.intent: Use lockfiles and approved registries, assess every direct and transitive component, and bind a CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM and verifiable provenance to the release.

controls.title: Build, sign, and deploy only through controlled identities
controls.intent: Produce releases from protected commits or tags using controlled CI, short-lived credentials, artifact signing, immutable digests, approvals, and verified deployment identity.

controls.title: Harden infrastructure and detect drift
controls.intent: Use infrastructure as code, private-by-default services, least-privilege IAM, segmentation, hardened images, patching, encryption, policy checks, and drift detection.

controls.title: Create authoritative, privacy-safe security logging
controls.intent: Define security events, keep sensitive values out of logs, protect authoritative server audit trails, synchronize time, control access, retain appropriately, and detect tampering.

controls.title: Monitor, alert, and respond to security signals
controls.intent: Detect identity, data, infrastructure, fraud, dependency, availability, and policy anomalies with owned alerts, tested escalation, and measurable coverage.

controls.title: Operate vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and disclosure
controls.intent: Track vulnerability sources, exploitability, known exploitation, remediation SLAs, emergency releases, dependency exposure, coordinated disclosure, and retesting.

controls.title: Maintain and exercise incident response
controls.intent: Define detection, triage, containment, evidence preservation, credential and key revocation, notification, recovery, communications, and post-incident improvement.

controls.title: Engineer availability, backups, restoration, and continuity
controls.intent: Set RTO/RPO, test backup integrity and restoration, handle dependency failure, enforce quotas, preserve rollback, and exercise continuity at the required risk tier.

controls.title: Assess vendors, SDKs, subprocessors, and shared responsibility
controls.intent: Perform risk-based due diligence, contract security/privacy duties, review current evidence, control access and data flow, monitor changes, and plan exit or failure.

controls.title: Operate personnel security and role-based training
controls.intent: Apply screening where permitted and required, confidentiality duties, secure onboarding/offboarding, role-based training, and developer security education.

controls.title: Document physical and environmental control inheritance
controls.intent: Identify facilities and devices in scope, verify physical protections or inherited cloud evidence, and document gaps in the shared-responsibility model.

controls.title: Pin and satisfy current Apple submission requirements
controls.intent: Recheck Apple requirements for the release date, use an accepted Xcode and iOS SDK, and archive the official requirement evidence.
evidence: Dated Apple requirements snapshot or locator

controls.title: Verify final archive identity, signing, entitlements, and release configuration
controls.intent: Inspect the distribution IPA/archive for approved signing identity, bundle IDs, provisioning, entitlements, embedded frameworks, no get-task-allow, no debug endpoints, and no test bypasses.

controls.title: Verify iOS dependency and SDK supply chain
controls.intent: Lock SwiftPM/CocoaPods and binary dependencies, verify origin and signatures, include every SDK in the SBOM, and trigger review on SDK changes.
evidence: SDK signature, origin, vulnerability, and privacy review

controls.title: Make privacy manifests, labels, consent, ATT, and behavior consistent
controls.intent: Verify every PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, required-reason API, tracking domain, SDK declaration, permission purpose, privacy label, policy, consent state, and observed transmission.

controls.title: Protect iOS secrets and local data
controls.intent: Use Keychain and appropriate Data Protection classes, exclude sensitive backups, minimize local storage, and delete tokens, caches, cookies, databases, and files on logout or account deletion.
evidence: Logout, deletion, and reinstall cleanup tests

controls.title: Secure iOS network, deep links, WebViews, and entry points
controls.intent: Keep ATS enabled, validate trust, scope exceptions, validate every deep link and imported object, isolate WebViews, restrict bridges and file access, and keep sensitive data out of push payloads.

controls.title: Secure iOS authentication, biometrics, and account lifecycle
controls.intent: Prefer passkeys; use system OAuth/OIDC with PKCE, state, nonce, exact redirects, and server validation; treat biometrics as local unlock; provide complete in-app account deletion where required.

controls.title: Protect sensitive iOS UI, logging, diagnostics, and accessibility paths
controls.intent: Prevent sensitive background snapshots, notifications, pasteboard, keyboard, accessibility, logs, crash data, and diagnostics from exposing protected data while keeping security flows operable with assistive technology.

controls.title: Inspect and dynamically test the final iOS release on real devices
controls.intent: Inspect the extracted IPA, entitlements, manifests, frameworks, strings, URL schemes, protections, and signing; run applicable MASTG tests on current and minimum supported iOS versions and real hardware.

controls.title: Apply threat-driven app integrity and fraud controls
controls.intent: For high-risk apps, use App Attest or equivalent signals with server challenges, replay protection, lifecycle handling, and risk-based responses; never substitute device checks for server authorization.
evidence: Replay, unsupported-device, rotation, and failure tests

controls.title: Inventory and govern AI systems, models, data, and vendors
controls.intent: Identify AI roles, models, prompts, training/retrieval data, vendors, evaluation boundaries, user disclosure, data-use terms, retention, security, and prohibited uses.

controls.title: Test and monitor AI security, safety, and decision risks
controls.intent: Evaluate prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool use, authorization, hallucination impact, bias, robustness, human oversight, appeal, drift, monitoring, and incident response according to risk.

controls.title: Minimize and isolate payment-card scope
controls.intent: Use validated payment providers and tokenization, avoid handling account data where possible, document CDE influence, secure payment flows, and obtain the correct validation route.

controls.title: Confirm regulated-health scope and protect ePHI
controls.intent: Confirm covered-entity/business-associate status, define the ePHI boundary, minimum necessary access, BAAs, auditability, retention, breach handling, and regulated vendor flows.

controls.title: Confirm regulated-finance scope and customer-information safeguards
controls.intent: Determine covered financial activity, protect customer information, oversee service providers, test incident and resilience duties, and capture contractual flow-downs.

controls.title: Protect children and verify parental controls where required
controls.intent: Determine child-directed or actual-knowledge scope, minimize collection, obtain valid parental consent, separate advertising consent, support deletion, and verify age/parental flows without dark patterns.

controls.title: Protect covered education records and institutional control
controls.intent: Confirm FERPA and state-law scope, document school-official/direct-control terms, restrict use and redisclosure, and test access, correction, export, retention, and deletion.

controls.title: Define federal, defense, and CUI authorization boundaries
controls.intent: Pin contract clauses and required revisions, identify FCI/CUI/CJI/federal data flows, inherited services, validated cryptography, assessment level, and authorized deployment boundary.

controls.title: Confirm EU cybersecurity and market-access obligations
controls.intent: Determine entity, sector, product, provider/deployer, member-state, reporting, conformity, vulnerability, and contractual scope for EU regimes before market release.
